name: paper-polisher-pro
description: AI writing detector (author self-check) + academic polishing guidance + terminology protection, 100% local. 12-layer recalibrated rule engine (L1-L12, discourse layer included) + token-spectrum layer + length-routed fusion + optional supervised Qwen3-0.6B ONNX layer (AUROC 0.9998 fingerprint-bound held-out) + LLM fingerprint attribution (GLM/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi/MiniMax/GPT/Claude/Gemini) + journal precheck + AIGC compliance label check + paragraph attribution + sentence-level rewrite suggestions (guidance, never auto-rewrite). Eval-driven: base-engine numbers reproduce via the bundled held-out evaluation; supervised-layer figures are author-side held-out measurements.
author: DoctorQ Lab
changelog: v7.9.0: manifest single-sourcing — the packager no longer overwrites data/INTEGRITY_MANIFEST.json (data-file semantics) with the all-package manifest; packaging now writes data/PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json covering every shipped file outside data/ (same sha256+bytes fields), and pp_doctor --deep verifies BOTH manifests when present (package-receipt acceptance: exact file + expected/actual hash on any drift); pkg reconciliation gates assert the two manifests' semantics and complementarity; release ledger --record made idempotent (same slug+version+platform skipped). No engine scoring changes. 零新增依赖。
